EA-CAND-ENV-LAYER-0001.timing: Immediate post-walk self-report in the studied session.
EA-CAND-ENV-LAYER-0001.population: Healthy adult and predominantly young-adult/student samples in specified field settings.
EA-CAND-ENV-LAYER-0001.operation: Specified low-intensity natural outdoor walk compared with a time/distance-matched urban or built-setting walk.
EA-CAND-ENV-LAYER-0001.scope: Immediate self-reported positive affect or mood-valence component only.
